name: Ichijou Meguru
source:
A quirky girl the protagonist met by chance.
Randomly breaks into samurai speech. Has a weird sense of humor.
Full of mysteries, like wandering the beach holding a trash bag,
Or being close with a mysterious creature "wataame".
Calls the protagonist "Yuki-nii". Dorayaki(Japanese red bean pancake) is her favorite food.
